items.name: Auto-sling
items.description: d20 7. −1 Max Speed; 120 ft (2 positions); up to 3 targets in the same position; 2d6 piercing.

items.name: Bolt thrower
items.description: d20 8. −1 Max Speed; 120 ft (2 positions); 6d12 piercing; reload as an action.

items.name: Ankheg spit launcher
items.description: d20 9. −1 Max Speed; 60 ft (1 position); 4d4 acid and −1 AC.

items.name: Chain gun
items.description: d20 10. −1 Max Speed; 60 ft (1 position); 3d6 bludgeoning and restrained (DC 13); reload as an action.

items.name: Thunder cannon
items.description: d20 11. −1 Max Speed; 60 ft (1 position); 3d8 thunder; driver must make a handling check.

items.name: Tyrant rifle
items.description: d20 12. 3 uses; 60 ft (1 position); 10d6 force or destroy a mod.

items.name: Magic missile launcher
items.description: d20 14. −1 Max Speed; 7 uses; 120 ft (2 positions); 3d4 + 3 force.

items.name: Flak cannon
items.description: d20 15. −1 Max Speed; 60 ft (1 position); 3d6 piercing; reload as an action.

items.name: Smokescreen projector
items.description: d20 16. Create a hazard directly behind you.

items.name: Grease sprayer
items.description: d20 17. Create a hazard directly behind you.

items.name: Oil sprayer
items.description: d20 18. Adjacent junk makes a handling check and becomes vulnerable to fire.

items.name: Flaming oil barrel
items.description: d20 19. −1 Max Speed; hazard directly behind you; 8d6 fire.

items.name: Cage of stirges
items.description: d20 20. 3d6 stirges attack occupants of a junk adjacent to or directly behind you.

monsters.name: Blitzwing
monsters.notes: Adult blue dragon. FIRST Blitzwing revealed: he passes high overhead, no fight, press Victory. SECOND Blitzwing: he strafes the party with Lightning Breath (DC 19 Dex, 12d10 lightning, half on a save), then returns to D. Blitzwing's Scrapyard; press Victory once resolved.

monsters.name: Ghouls
monsters.notes: A gang of 1d4 + 2 ghouls dressed as junk racers descend on the party.

monsters.name: Black Pudding
monsters.notes: A random character accidentally steps into what looks like a puddle of oil, but it is actually a black pudding.
